evidence: The process parameters such as the reaction time, gas ﬂow rate, growth temperature, and plasma power were investigated under various conditions to stabilize and optimize process conditions. TDMAT was delivered from an external reservoir at 40°C and pulsed into the reactor using Ar carrier gas with the ﬂow rate of 20 sccm. Ar purge gas ﬂow rate was ﬁxed at 100 sccm. Each process times of TDMAT, Ar-purge, remote plasma, Ar-purge were ﬁxed to be 5, 10, 10, and 10 s, respectively. TiN ﬁlms were deposited at 250°C and the process pressure was kept constant using a throttle valve.
